name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
summary: A row of toggle buttons where one or several stay pressed.
description: A row of Toggles where one stays pressed (text alignment, a view) or, multiple, several (bold, italic, underline). Each item is the Toggle: the same looks, sizes, shapes, square and muted, the same pressed fill; icon-only items are named and tipped by their labels (a Tooltip). One tab stop, arrow keys move between the items, Space / Enter press. Unlike the segmented control there is no track and no sliding thumb, and nothing has to be pressed. Behaviour by Ark UI's toggle-group (Zag). Controlled or uncontrolled.

anatomy.description: Ark's toggle-group root: role=radiogroup when one at most, role=group with multiple. Outline items are joined into one control, as a button group joins Buttons: square inner corners, one hairline at each join; a press dims the pressed item and moves nothing. Ghost (borderless) items sit 2px apart. It wraps rather than overflowing. Vertical: a column of full-width items, their content at the start.

One Toggle (the toggle recipe's classes): role=radio with aria-checked when one at most, aria-pressed with multiple (styled from those: a Tooltip around an icon-only item writes its own data-state on it). Pressed: hover-2, hovered or not; muted turns ink. Only one item is in the tab order.

The Toggle's label part: cut at the end with a title when the item has less room. Not shown on a square item that has an icon: its label is then its aria-label and its tooltip. A square item without an icon shows its (short) label and is named by its tooltip when it has one.

items.description: The toggles, in order. Strings are accepted as value = label. Each may carry an icon (a node in React).

multiple.description: Several may be pressed at once. Otherwise one at most.

deselectable.description: One at most: a click on the pressed item releases it. false keeps one pressed once chosen.

size.description: The Toggle's sizes. The one control height scale: xs 24px, sm 28px, md 32px, lg 36px (an sm Toggle lines up with an sm Button or Select). Dimensions only, as the Button.

shape.description: The shape of the toggles, as on Toggle. Left out, the app's shape: a pill, or rounded in a rounded app ("shape": "rounded" in the project's fndn.json).

square.description: Icon-only items, as wide as they are tall; each label names its item and is its tooltip.

muted.description: Quiet at rest, ink when hovered, held down or pressed: ink-3 for icon-only items (square), ink-2 for items with a label.

orientation.description: vertical: a column; Arrow Up / Down move.

events.valueChange: (value: string[]) after a click, Space or Enter

a11y.role: radiogroup of radios while one at most can be pressed; group of toggle buttons (aria-pressed) with multiple
keyboard: Tab moves into the group (to the last focused item) and out of it
Arrow Right / Arrow Left (vertical: Arrow Down / Arrow Up) move to the next / previous item, wrapping; mirrored right-to-left
Home / End: the first / last item
Space / Enter press or release the focused item
notes: One at most: role=radiogroup with role=radio items and aria-checked. Multiple: role=group with toggle buttons and aria-pressed.
Name the group with aria-label. Icon-only items are named by their labels (aria-label), which their Tooltips show.
To set it from outside, control `value`: React value / onValueChange.

motion: the Toggle's: press scales to motion.press-scale; hover fill and colour over duration.fast (pointer only)
pressed fill: over duration.fast from a pointer; instant from the keyboard (kbd-instant)
focus moves between the items instantly
